pad.title: Why professionals choose YAYA
pad.description: The old housing model was designed for people who stay put. YAYA was designed for you.

items.title: Radical flexibility
items.description: Move on your schedule, not your landlord's. YAYA spaces have rolling monthly stays with no penalty for changing plans.

items.title: Instant community
items.description: Every YAYA property is a vetted community of remote workers, entrepreneurs, and creatives. You don't have to earn your way in — it's built into the platform.

items.title: All-in-one cost
items.description: Rent, utilities, wifi, cleaning, and community access — one predictable monthly bill. No surprises, no deposits, no broker fees.

items.title: Global network coverage
items.description: YAYA operates in multiple cities and is expanding. Your MyPass works across the entire network, so relocating feels like checking into a familiar place.

pad.title: The world changed. Where you live should too.
pad.body:
Millions of remote workers, digital nomads, and mobile professionals face the same paradox: they can work from anywhere, but their housing hasn't caught up. Short-term rentals are expensive and impersonal. Long-term leases kill flexibility. Hotels are lonely and draining.

YAYA was built to close that gap. We designed a living platform where flexibility and community coexist — where you can move between cities without losing your home, your people, or your sense of belonging.

pad.title: The YAYA Platform
pad.description: From your living passport to curated spaces around the world — everything you need to live fully mobile.

items.name: MyPass
items.tagline: Your living passport for the modern professional.
items.description: MyPass is your all-access membership to the YAYA network. One pass, one monthly plan, unlimited flexibility. Book any YAYA-certified space, access community perks, and carry your living history wherever you go.

items.name: YAYA Houses
items.description: Fully furnished shared houses in urban neighborhoods — curated for professionals who want real community, not just a roof. Private rooms, shared common areas, and a built-in social layer.

items.name: YAYA Apartments
items.description: Studio and one-bedroom apartments inside YAYA buildings. You get your own space plus full access to shared community floors, events, and the MyPass network.

items.name: YAYA Hotels
items.description: YAYA-certified hotel suites designed for extended stays. Work-ready rooms, community programming, and MyPass integration so you never feel like just a guest.

items.name: Community Spaces
items.tagline: Where YAYA members meet and build.
items.description: Coworking floors, event rooms, rooftop terraces, and maker workshops embedded in every YAYA property. Open to all MyPass members, reserved for the community.
